```json
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Store requirements permanently and securely",
    "req_ids": ["RE011"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Doorstop is initialized"],
    "inputs": {"storage_medium": "database"},
    "steps": ["Save requirement to storage"],
    "expected": ["Requirement is stored without data loss"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Handle change management of requirements",
    "req_ids": ["RE012"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Doorstop has existing requirements"],
    "inputs": {"change_request": "new_requirement"},
    "steps": ["Process change request"],
    "expected": ["Change is managed and tracked"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Associate requirement changes to developer identification",
    "req_ids": ["RE013"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Developer is identified"],
    "inputs": {"developer_id": "12345", "change_request": "modified_requirement"},
    "steps": ["Link change to developer"],
    "expected": ["Developer is associated with the change"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Scalability to support thousands of requirements",
    "req_ids": ["RE014"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Doorstop has a large dataset"],
    "inputs": {"dataset_size": "10000"},
    "steps": ["Test scalability"],
    "expected": ["Doorstop handles large dataset without performance degradation"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Provide a lightweight installation method",
    "req_ids": ["RE015"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Doorstop is ready for installation"],
    "inputs": {"installation_method": "lightweight_package"},
    "steps": ["Install Doorstop"],
    "expected": ["Doorstop is installed with minimal resource usage"]
  }
]
